mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY < -10% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 2% does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises & PAYEMS falls does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 5% does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -1% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
